senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to cut off,] to withhold, refuse, refrain.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 113b:14">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>המוֹנֵעַ מנעלים מרגליו</he> he who denies shoes to his feet.
<cite ref="Ketubot 96a:6">Keth. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>המונע תלמידו מלשמשו כאילו מונע וכ׳</he> he who denies to his pupil the privilege of attendance, is considered as if denying kindness to him.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:31">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>אל יִמְנַע עצמו מן הרחמים</he> must not cut himself off from (despair of) divine mercy.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76:9">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Job 6:14">Job VI, 14</cite>) <he>מָנַעְתָּ מרעך וכ׳</he> thou (Jacob) didst refuse kindness to thy friend (Job); a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 4:8">Eduy. IV, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 1:4">Yeb. I, 4</cite> <he>לא נִמְנְעוּ</he> (<cite ref="M00000"><he>מ</he></cite>)<he>לישא וכ׳</he> they did not refrain from intermarriage.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נ׳</he> (<he>להיות</he>) <he>עושין טהרות וכ׳</he> they did not shrink from relying on one another in the observances of levitical pureness; Tosef. ib. I, 10. Ib. 12 <he>מן הספק לא היו נִמְנָעִין</he> (<cite ref="A00153"><he>אבל</he></cite>) <he>נמנעין וכ׳</he> they did not shrink (from interchange) where the case was doubtful &c.; <cite ref="Yevamot 14b">Yeb. 14ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 36a">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>נמנעו מלהלוות וכ׳</he> they hesitated to lend money to one another; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>נִמְנְעָה השמחה וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>נִמְנַעַת</he>) joy was withheld from the wicked and given to &c.

senses.gloss: to keep apart. Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ top שאת מַמְנִיעָן זו מזו for thou keepest them (the rain-drops) from commingling (v. דָּפוּס); Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ top ממנימען (corr. acc.).
